title: Chinese Cabbage Potstickers
ldIngredientsRaw: 500 g pork ( , slightly more than 1 pound, with lean and fat and finely minced; you can use ground pork too)
500 g Chinese cabbage or more if you love to have more vegetables
1 tablespoon salt for marinating the cabbage
1 tablespoon oil for frying the potstickers
ldInstructionsRaw: Finely mince the cabbage and mix with 1 tablespoon of salt in a large bowl. Set aside for 10-15 minutes. Then wash the cabbage twice to remove extra salt. Squeeze the water out slightly.
In another mixing bowl, mix ground pork with all the other seasonings. Continue stirring the meat filling in one direction for 1 or 2 minutes or until sticky. Add cabbage and combine well.
